privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.notice: This baseline text is a customization prompt, not a production privacy policy or legal advice. Replace it before launching a fork.

information.title: Information and purpose
information.description: Describe the information your fork collects, why it is needed, whether it is required, and how people can review or correct it.

providers.title: Providers and sharing
providers.description: List every enabled authentication, payment, storage, analytics, email, AI, and abuse-defense provider together with the information each provider receives.

abuseDefense.title: Abuse defense
abuseDefense.description: When Turnstile is enabled, the magic-link pages load Cloudflare's challenge script and frame, which let Cloudflare process browser and network signals to distinguish people from bots. The application sends the resulting opaque token to Cloudflare Siteverify, but does not add the optional visitor IP field, enable widget failure feedback, retain the token or provider response in application data or ordinary logs, or surface provider error codes. Describe your deployment's actual configuration and retention, and link to Cloudflare's {addendum}.

retention.title: Retention and choices
retention.description: State the real retention periods, account-deletion behavior, billing-history exceptions, security controls, and a working contact method for privacy questions.

terms.title: Terms
terms.notice: This baseline text is a customization prompt, not production terms or legal advice. Replace it before launching a fork.

service.title: The service
service.description: Describe what your fork provides, who may use it, and any eligibility or account requirements.

conduct.title: Acceptable use
conduct.description: Document the conduct, content, automation, and abuse rules that are appropriate for the actual product.

payments.title: Payments and ending access
payments.description: If billing is enabled, explain the real price, renewal, cancellation, refund, account-deletion, and family access behavior.

home.title: A simple, private place to begin.
home.introduction: Start with passwordless access and data that belongs to each person. Add family access or collaborative features only when the product needs them.

passwordless.title: Email and configured providers

private.title: Your data stays yours

adapt.title: Share only what matters
adapt.description: A fork can add focused collaboration to the specific feature that needs it.
